prediction_meaning: Probability that a donor with >= 1 previous donation makes a voluntary donation in the next month, given recency/frequency/tenure in months.
not_for: Emergency invitation-response probability; clinical eligibility; individual-level decisions without human review.

training_data.name: UCI Blood Transfusion Service Center
training_data.citation: Yeh, I-Cheng, Yang, King-Jang, and Ting, Tao-Ming, 'Knowledge discovery on RFM model using Bernoulli sequence', Expert Systems with Applications, 2008, doi:10.1016/j.eswa.2008.07.018
training_data.population: 748 donors randomly selected from the donor database of the Blood Transfusion Service Center, Hsin-Chu City, Taiwan

nested_cv_estimate.protocol: 5x5 repeated stratified CV, tuning + calibration nested
